GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE.description: Search for files and folders in Google Drive using query parameters. Supports advanced search with operators like 'name contains', 'mimeType =', 'trashed = false', etc. Returns a list of files matching the criteria with their metadata including id, name, mimeType, size, createdTime, modifiedTime, and more.

q.description: Query string for searching files. Use operators like 'name contains', 'mimeType =', 'trashed = false', 'parents in', etc. Example: "name contains 'report' and trashed = false"

pageToken.description: Token for retrieving the next page of results. Use the nextPageToken from the previous response.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of files to return per page. Default is 100, maximum is 1000.

corpora.description: Comma-separated list of corpora to search. Possible values: 'user', 'drive', 'allDrives'. Default is 'user'.

includeItemsFromAllDrives.description: Whether to include items from all drives. Default is false.

supportsAllDrives.description: Whether the requesting application supports both My Drives and shared drives. Default is false.

fields.description: Selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response. Example: 'files(id,name,mimeType)'

orderBy.description: Sort order for results. Example: 'modifiedTime desc', 'name', 'createdTime'

spaces.description: Comma-separated list of spaces to query. Supported values: 'drive', 'appDataFolder', 'photos'.

GOOGLEDRIVE_DOWNLOAD_FILE.description: Download a file from Google Drive. Returns the file content as a downloadable URL (s3url). For Google Workspace files (Docs, Sheets, Slides), use GOOGLEDRIVE_EXPORT_GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_FILE instead.

file_id.description: The ID of the file to download. Can be obtained from GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE or other file listing operations.

mime_type.description: MIME type for export (only for Google Workspace files). Examples: 'application/pdf', 'text/plain', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document'

acknowledgeAbuse.description: Whether the user is acknowledging the risk of downloading known malware or other abusive files. Default is false.

s3url.description: Presigned S3 URL to download the file content. Use HTTP GET to retrieve the actual file.

steps: Step 1: Use COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS to discover available tools for your use case
Step 2: Use COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS to verify authentication status
Step 3: Use GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE with query parameter 'q' to search for files
Step 4: Extract file_id from the search results
Step 5: Use GOOGLEDRIVE_DOWNLOAD_FILE with the file_id to download content
Step 6: Process the downloaded content using COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH if needed

pitfalls: Remember to add 'and trashed = false' to the query to exclude deleted files
Use 'contains' instead of exact match for partial name searches
For Shared Drives, set includeItemsFromAllDrives=true and supportsAllDrives=true
Download returns s3url, not direct content - use HTTP GET to retrieve
Google Workspace files require EXPORT instead of DOWNLOAD
Pagination: use nextPageToken from response for subsequent requests
Query syntax is case-insensitive for operators but case-sensitive for values
